title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations
summary: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a 0.57-second response time. Elevenlabs says no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard is both faster and more accurate. The article Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
